Players Committee card image of [[Admiral Motti (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Chiraneau may not modify your Force drains. Kuat Drive Yards is [Immune to Alter]. Unless your Senate on table, unique (•) Star Destroyers are power +2 and immunity to attrition +1. Once per game, may deploy non-[Set 0] Kuat Drive Yards from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
